messages:
jamie: Heads-up — planned production deploy (r2.3.0) in 30m. Window 16:00-16:30 PT. Posting the pre-deploy checklist and sign-offs here, please ack and add any blockers.

jamie: Pre-deploy checklist:
- [x] Merge queue clear (main at HEAD)
- [x] CI: e2e + integration green (build #4218)
- [ ] DB migrations reviewed (runbook + rollback verified)
- [x] Canary image built and pushed to registry
- [ ] Oncall & deploy owner assigned
- [x] Release notes updated + internal changelog
- Smoke tests scripted and ready
- Rollback plan documented (tag + rollback job ready)

jamie: Docs/commands below for quick reference for whoever runs the deploy:
```bash
# start canary
./deploy/run --env=prod --strategy=canary --percent=5 --tag=r2.3.0
# smoke test (simple checks)
./scripts/smoke_check.sh --env=prod --url=https://api.redwood.ai/health
# rollback
./deploy/rollback --env=prod --tag=r2.2.9
```

alex: ACK. I can own the deploy and be onsite in the channel. I'll set the canary to 5% then wait 10m and bump if green.

maya: ACK from QA. Smoke script covers: health, token latency, a sampled generation check. Quick sample output expectation:
```
health: OK
latency_p50: <120ms
model_samplegen: "Hello" response within 2 tokens of golden
```
If anything fails, we revert to r2.2.9 and open an incident.

alex: Quick check on migrations — @sylvia can you confirm the migration has no long locks? I saw the migration SQL but want a second eyeball.

sylvia: Reviewed the migration. It's additive + index creation with CONCURRENT where possible. Timing estimate: ~30s per shard, low risk. Marking migration as reviewed.

jamie: Perfect — marking DB migrations as reviewed now. sylvia -> thanks.

oncall-sre: Oncall here. I'll monitor infra metrics and be ready to scale if CPU on inference hosts spikes during canary. If we need to roll back, ping me and I'll kick the rollback job.

alex: Starting canary in 3m. Will post status updates and timestamps.

deploy-bot: canary-started | tag=r2.3.0 | percent=5 | ts=1763001335

alex: Canary up. Initial checks: health OK, no 5xx, p50 latency 98ms. Leaving it at 5% for 10m.

maya: Running smoke script now (kicking off the scripted suite).

maya: Smoke results: health OK, latency_p50 110ms, sample generation match pass. No anomalies detected.

alex: Bumping to 25% per plan.

deploy-bot: canary-update | tag=r2.3.0 | percent=25 | ts=1763001398

alex: 25% running. Monitoring logs for errors and model quality drift.

oncall-sre: Metrics look clean. Memory and CPU stable. No rollback needed so far.

jamie: Thanks all — can everyone add their final sign-off text as a quick reply? Need deploy owner + QA + oncall.

alex: Sign-off: deploy owner, I ran the canary rollout & verified checks. Proceed to 100% when you want me to.

maya: Sign-off: QA, smoke script and sampled evals pass.

oncall-sre: Sign-off: oncall, infra stable, ready to escalate if needed.

sylvia: Sign-off: migrations good.

jamie: Proceeding to full rollout in 5m. Will update with final completion timestamp.

deploy-bot: rollout-complete | tag=r2.3.0 | ts=1763001450 | status=success

alex: Completed. All services at r2.3.0. No errors observed for 10m post-rollout. :tada:

maya: Noticed a minor telemetry gap for a single route (~1min), filing a post-deploy follow-up ticket (TICKET-1184). Not blocking.

jamie: Great run — thanks everyone. Adding follow-up note in release doc. (reacted :thumbsup:)
